text:
rachel: March bracket update! whos in for the office pool? $10 buy-in, winner gets the trophy + chili cookoff immunity.
tom: i'm in. chili immunity is the real prize. also i demand a tiny trophy.
devin: count me in. will defend my 2022 title (questionable).
karla: in. but my bracket is cursed. may need moral support.
evan: i'm 50/50. do we allow last-minute swaps?
gamedaybot: Poll created by rachel: "Join office March pool?" Options: 1) Yes - $10 2) No 3) Spectate. React with :one:, :two:, :three:.
rachel: also proposing a tiebreaker: if brackets tie, the tied managers do a chili cookoff judged by ops team. winner gets immunity and the loser brings snacks for a week. fair?
tom: :one: + cookoff rules sound dramatic but fair. i will bring secret ingredient.
devin: :one: and i will accept the chili duel. my recipe is undefeated.
karla: :one: but marinaded in sympathy for my bracket luck.
evan: :three: i'll spectate and bring cornbread.
gamedaybot: Poll closed. Results: 1) Yes - 4 votes, 2) No - 0 votes, 3) Spectate - 1 vote. Outcome: Pool confirmed.
rachel: sheet up: https://tiny.redwood/march-mini-pool add name / email / paid?y/n / tiebreaker minute guess
tom: paid Venmo @tom-takes-trophies. added picks.
devin: Venmo paid. picking chaos.
karla: cash on my desk labeled "bracket penance". added picks.
evan: added spectate note and cornbread promise.
rachel: cookoff sign-up: if tied, winners choose theme (chipotle, smoky, vegan, surprise). agree?
tom: surprise theme = chaos spice. approved.
devin: calling dibs on smoke ring technique.
karla: vote for vegan options being eligible too please.
rachel: noted. judges = ops + facilities + someone from product. impartiality negotiable.
gamedaybot: Reminder scheduled: Bracket entries close Thu 11:59pm.
tom: tiny side-bet: loser has to wear the trophy as a hat for an hour in the kitchen. stakes accepted?
devin: accepted. hats are humiliating and glorious.
karla: can we have a consolation prize for best upset pick? small gift card?
rachel: yes, $25 coffee card for the best upset predictor.
evan: i'm bringing a tray of cornbread just in case.
rachel: perfect. final reminder: pay up before midnight and good luck. bracket drama mandatory. :trophy::chili_pepper:
